subject: FIRST PHONE ENCODE: two daemon-side items from opus-kern (image q10jw is ready)
body: q10jw (kernel with 0310/0311) is built. The GCE lists are interpreted in V40's gce_run_list(): good. Two things the DAEMON/V40 must do for the first on-phone encode: (1) POWER VEN around every job: the library sends no power message in GCE mode (Linux powers the encoder at the first GCE flush): V40/IP must call the kernel's power ioctl (RWVC power on) before executing a GCE list and off after (or keep on with a timeout), with the clock knob 'slow' for the first encode (hwv.py step1 --slow = 273 MHz: expose as a daemon flag --venc-slow that sets it before the first job); (2) give the vendor library slbc_ready = 0 (we route its on-chip-SRAM ports to DRAM): find where the library reads it (a property/ioctl value: VCU_...?), V40/V34 shim it as 0. Then rebuild the iOS product (bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh and bash gpu/hwcodec/ios/build.sh) and post DONE with the sha of vcodecd. Main session assembles the payload and flashes right after: this is the critical path; please finish within ~30 minutes.
